entities.summary: Haris Pamboukis is a Greek Academic, Professor Emeritus of private international law and international business transactions at the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens, Faculty of Law (1991-2025), lawyer licensed to practice law before the Supreme Court and ex Minister of State in the government of George Papandreou (2009-2011). He is the author of numerous articles in Greek, English, and French, and has published several legal monographs, legal opinions and political essays.
